name: resistance band one leg kickback (bent position)
description: A standing glute kickback with a band while leaning forward, isolating one hip at a time.
instructions: Loop a resistance band around your ankle and anchor the other end low in front of you.
Hold a support and lean forward slightly.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Kick your leg back and up against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.
